name: What is the best way to prepare walls for interior paint touch-ups?

mainEntity.name: What is the best way to prepare walls for interior paint touch-ups?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper preparation is key for seamless interior paint touch-ups. Begin by cleaning the wall surface with a mild soap and water solution to remove any dirt, grease, or dust. Rinse thoroughly and allow it to dry completely. For minor scuffs, a magic eraser can be effective. If there are any small holes or cracks, fill them with spackle, sand smooth once dry, and clean off any dust. Ensure the surface is free of any imperfections that could show through the new paint layer. This meticulous preparation helps the new paint blend in and prevents future peeling or uneven finishes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clean the wall surface thoroughly, removing dirt and grease. Fill small holes or cracks with spackle and sand smooth for best results.
